labels: Sections marked synthetic come from assumed inputs and are not measurements of any project. The section observed_quality_trend is computed from the pinned repository extract.

rules.naive: each tau exceeds z * sd(tau) computed as if the rolling values were independent
rules.calibrated: min tau >= the value exceeded by the false-alarm target share of independent stationary calibration runs

observed_quality_trend.reason: A window whose values are all equal has variance 0 and a lag-1 autocorrelation of 0/0. Where the series does change, it changes by isolated steps shared by many artifacts, not by fluctuations around a level.
